passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: To establish an enabling environment to reduce the drop outs and to promote the enrolment of girl child belonging to SC/ST communities in secondary schools and ensure their retention up to the 18 years of age.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 1, para 3 Objective

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: The Scheme will cover (i) all SC/ST girls who pass class VIII and (ii) girls, who pass class VIII examination from Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidhalayas (irrespective of whether they belong to Scheduled Castes or Tribes) and enroll for class IX in State/UT Government, Government-aided or local body schools in the academic year 2008-09 onwards.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 1, para 4.1

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: To be eligible for the benefit under the scheme the girl should be unmarried and should be below 16 years of age (as on 31st March) on joining class IX.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 2, para 4.3

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: There would be no restriction based on income criteria for grant of incentive to girls, because SC/ST girls and girls passing out from KGBVs and studying in Government, Government-aided and local body schools would generally be from disadvantaged section of the society.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 2, para 4.5

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: Married girls will be excluded from the scheme.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 1, para 4.1

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: Girl children studying in private unaided schools are proposed to be excluded since a majority of such schools charge high fees and therefore, parents of such girl students may not require the financial assistance that is being offered under this scheme. Students enrolled in schools run by Central Government are also being excluded from the scheme, as these children are either fully provided for already, or are those of Central Government employees, who can afford education of their children, without further support.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 1, para 4.1

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: A sum of Rs. 3000 (Rupees three thousand only) would be deposited under term deposit/ fixed deposit in a public sector bank or in a post office in the name of every eligible girl child.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 2, para 6 Financial Parameters

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: The term/ period of the deposit may be counted from the date of deposit to the date on which the girl child attains the age of 18 years. No premature withdrawal will be allowed.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 2, para 6 Financial Parameters

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: The girl child receiving incentive may be entitled to draw the amount on attainment of 18 years of age.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 2, para 4.2

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: The beneficiary will have to continue her study at least for two years in the secondary school after her enrollment in Class IX in order to avail the benefit under the scheme. The Principal/ Head of the school will furnish a certificate to this effect.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 3, para 7.7

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: To be eligible to draw the matured amount a pre-condition would be for the beneficiary to pass class X Board examination successfully.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 3, para 7.8

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: On attaining 18 years of age and production of (i) 10th class pass certificate and (ii) a certificate from the Principal / Head of the school that the girl beneficiary has continued her study for at least two years after enrolment in Class IX the implementing agency will authorize the bank to transfer the matured amount in the interest bearing account to the savings account in the name of the girl beneficiary.

source.publisher: Department of School Education and Literacy, Government of India
source.locator: Scheme guidelines PDF (scanned; read from page image); p. 3, para 7.9

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text: Every implementing school may prepare a proposal for release of amount of incentive after proper examining the eligibility criteria and submit it to the State Governments/ UTs through proper channel.

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text:
Step 1: Visit the Registration page of the National Scholarships Portal.
Step 2: Guidelines for Registration will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read carefully the undertaking. Accept the Terms. Click “Continue”.
Step 3: A Registration Form will appear. (The fields marked as * are compulsory). Fill in the details and click “Register”. Your Application ID and password will be displayed. The same will also be sent as an SMS to your registered mobile number.

source.publisher: Ministry of Education
source.locator: myScheme page; Application Process, Online, new registration

passages.scheme_name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
passages.text:
Step 1: Visit the applicant Login page of the National Scholarships Portal Enter your Application ID and password.
Step 2: Type the Captcha and click “Login”.
Step 3: On the next screen, provide the OTP received on your registered mobile number. You will be directed to the Password Reset screen. Create a new password and confirm.
Step 4: Click “Submit”. You will be directed to the “Applicant’s Dashboard”.
Step 5: On the left pane, click “Application Form”. The fields marked as * are compulsory. Fill in the details and upload the documents. The verification of credentials of the students (caste, educational qualifications etc.) will be done through the DIGILOCKER facility of the MeitY, Govt. of India.
Step 6: You can either click on “Save as Draft” to complete the application later. Else, click “Final Submit” to apply.
